name: camera_volume and camera_shot entity kinds in the world editor
body: Two world-file kinds a level designer places in the world editor. camera_volume: an axis-aligned box (`half_extents` property) that changes how the follow rig behaves while the player is inside (`distance`, `shoulder`, `pitch`, `fov`, `height`, `priority`, `blend` seconds). camera_shot: a framed view from the entity's position at a `target` point (`fov`, `blend`, `hold_input`), attached to a camera_volume by `volume` name so the shot is active while the player is in that volume. Add palette entries and editor markers so they can be placed and seen.

comments.text: Done: palette entries and sphere/capsule markers. The editor does not draw the box or preview a shot; see the follow-up cards.

acceptance_criteria: Both kinds are in assets/editor/palette.json with sensible defaults
The editor draws a marker for each
A world file using them loads with no script error
